import json,subprocess,tempfile,os,struct,time,statistics,hashlib
from pathlib import Path
root=Path.cwd();plat='windows' if os.name=='nt' else 'linux';target='x86_64-windows-gnu' if os.name=='nt' else 'x86_64-linux-musl';ext='.exe' if os.name=='nt' else ''
base=root/'.work/1069'/f'{target}-g1a1e1/bin'/('sigma'+ext);excluded=root/'.work/1069'/f'{target}-no-image/bin'/('sigma'+ext)
results={'platform':plat,'samples':{},'checks':[]}
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='supplement-',dir=root/'.work/1069') as d:
 folder=Path(d)
 def call(bin,args,expected=0):
  p=subprocess.run([str(bin),*args],cwd=folder,input=b'',capture_output=True,timeout=20)
  assert p.returncode==expected and not p.stderr,(args,p.returncode,p.stdout,p.stderr)
  return p.stdout.decode()
 def save(name,source,options=[]):
  path=folder/(name+ext);call(base,[*options,'-e',source+f' SAVESYS {path.name} BYE']);return path
 app=save('entry',': HELPER 42 . ; : MAIN HELPER ; \' MAIN APP-ENTRY!')
 text=call(app,['--sigma','--trace','--profile','--debug-log','run.jsonl','--'])
 assert '42' in text and (folder/'run.jsonl').stat().st_size>0,text
 results['checks'].append('restored-entry-trace-profile-log')
 loop=save('loop',': MAIN BEGIN AGAIN ; \' MAIN APP-ENTRY!')
 assert 'STEP LIMIT' in call(loop,['--sigma','--max-steps','1000','--'],1)
 results['checks'].append('entry-cli-step-limit')
 frame=app.read_bytes();length=struct.unpack_from('<I',frame,len(frame)-12)[0];image=frame[-20-length:-20]
 raw=excluded.read_bytes();blocked=folder/('blocked'+ext);blocked.write_bytes(raw+image+b'SIGEND01'+struct.pack('<IQ',len(image),len(raw)));blocked.chmod(0o700)
 assert 'INVALID IMAGE' in call(blocked,['-e','42 . BYE'],1)
 results['checks'].append('image-disabled-host-rejects-embedded-registered-image')
 for label,allocation,opts in [('small',0,[]),('large',8*1024*1024,['-m','16M'])]:
  sample=save(label,f'{allocation} ALLOT : MAIN ; \' MAIN APP-ENTRY!',opts)
  # Whole process time includes both image validation passes, restore, runtime setup and teardown.
  call(sample,[]);times=[]
  for _ in range(15):
   start=time.perf_counter_ns();call(sample,[]);times.append((time.perf_counter_ns()-start)/1e6)
  results['samples'][label]={'executable_bytes':sample.stat().st_size,'image_bytes':struct.unpack_from('<I',sample.read_bytes(),sample.stat().st_size-12)[0],'milliseconds':times,'median_ms':statistics.median(times),'min_ms':min(times),'max_ms':max(times)}
print(json.dumps(results,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))
